parameter_refs.name: signal_phase_schedule
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: steady green, steady yellow and subsequent red phases recorded by original Native frame

parameter_refs.name: body_entry_target_frame
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: approach entry before, at, after red onset or stop before entry

quote: Where the signal is a steady yellow signal alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal is thereby warned that the related green movement is being terminated or that a steady red indication will be exhibited immediately thereafter, and such vehicular traffic must not enter the intersection when the red signal is exhibited.

activation.condition: Vehicular traffic faces a steady yellow signal alone

obligation.description: Vehicular traffic must not enter the intersection when the red signal is exhibited

timing.description: Yellow warns termination of green or immediately subsequent red; compare original red exhibition with first complete-body intersection entry
